title: HRSA Award CE152893 — The Fresno Center Construction Grant Record

communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the Freedom of Information Act, I hereby request the following records:

Pursuant to the Freedom of Information Act, 5 U.S.C. § 552, I request copies of the following records concerning HRSA Grant/Award Number CE152893 (Community Project Funding / Congressionally Directed Spending - Construction), awarded in the amount of $1,500,000 on September 21, 2023, to The Fresno Center (UEI: ELF9NRA6G3T6, EIN: 77-0280265), listing project/recipient addresses at 4879 E. Kings Canyon Rd, Fresno, CA 93727 and 1725 N. Fine Ave, Fresno, CA 93727:
1. Approved Project Narrative / Scope of Work, specifically identifying the physical project site address(es) and planned facility improvements, renovations, or equipment purchases.
2. Approved Budget Information — Construction Programs (Form SF-424C) and Budget Justification, including line-item cost breakdowns across construction, renovation, architectural/engineering fees, and equipment.
3. Notice(s) of Award (NoA), including the initial September 21, 2023 award and subsequent administrative modifications issued in October and November 2023.
4. Federal Financial Reports (Form SF-425) and Final/Interim Progress Reports submitted by the recipient detailing actual expenditures and project completion status under Award CE152893.
Please provide all responsive records in electronic format (PDF).

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 20 business days, as the statute requires.

Sincerely,

Fresno
